research.notes: Agenda contracting entity is T-Mobile USA, Inc. (also written T-Mobile, Inc.), a subsidiary of the publicly traded parent T-Mobile US, Inc. Legal name left null to avoid conflating parent and subsidiary. Address and phone are the parent's principal executive offices as shown in an SEC filing. T-Mobile's own site (t-mobile.com, investor.t-mobile.com) blocks automated fetching, so website was not cited and is null. Piggyback agreement vendor; OUSD may be using a public-agency master contract.

profile.summary: T-Mobile is a wireless carrier based in Bellevue, Washington. Its parent company, T-Mobile US, Inc., is publicly traded and majority owned by Deutsche Telekom. It provides mobile phone and internet service to consumers and businesses in the United States.

sources.title: #OaklandUndivided Begins Distributing Laptops and Wireless Hotspots to Oakland Families

review.notes: Agenda names T-Mobile USA, Inc. / T-Mobile, Inc. in Bellevue, WA; the SEC filing confirms the T-Mobile US, Inc. parent's Bellevue address and phone, Wikipedia supports the summary, and the Oakland Public Education Fund page confirms T-Mobile hotspots for OUSD students via #OaklandUndivided. The address and phone are the parent's headquarters, consistent with the Bellevue location in the agenda.
